what: White haze over the plane — fbm cloud masses drift slowly right and slightly down (.018 per second, coarse-grain twist .24), and during 72~88% of the attached section’s progress the coverage threshold drops from .72 to 0, covering the screen (the bottom 45% always has a threshold .46 lower so it thickens first). During 78~92% the gaps between clouds fill in until it becomes a single white sheet at 92%, then it clears during 94~100% and hands off to the next scene. Density goes .85 → 1. Rendered at half screen resolution, 30 frames per second

options.start · cover · clear: Progress at which the cover starts, is fully covered, and starts lifting, default .72 · .88 · .94
options.res: Render resolution (share of panel size), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=track]: (If present) Section to measure progress — parent if absent

from.where: index.html .fd-fog (About section fog — original #mvFogCanvas: fbm threshold mix(.72,0,dis) − .46 below, solid smoothstep(.78,.92), fade 1−smoothstep(.92,1), density mix(.85,1), dissolve = t<.88 ? clamp((t−.72)/.16)·.92 : .92+clamp((t−.94)/.06)·.08, pixelRatio .5, 30fps)

note: The original reads noise from a 256px tile baked on the CPU. The part makes the same grain with value noise inside the shader
